evidence: src/infrastructure/in-memory-product-repository.ts: class InMemoryProductRepository implements ProductRepository and keeps the data in a private Map<string, Product>. This is storage work, which belongs in infrastructure.
findById, findAll and save only call Map get/values/set. They contain no domain rules or decisions.
constructor(seed) only fills the Map with products. It does not validate or change them.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is in the infrastructure layer. It does one job: it implements the domain ProductRepository port using an in-memory Map, which is a persistence adapter. The methods findById, findAll and save only store and fetch Product objects. They contain no business rules, validation, pricing or stock logic, and no orchestration of use cases. The constructor only seeds the store. All of this fits the infrastructure role.
